_comment: Phase-4 mutation-testing PILOT (tooling-roadmap #5). Run manually: npx stryker run (from this package). Deliberately NOT wired into CI — the pilot measures whether the DOM specs catch real bugs; see plans/testing/angular-dom-testing-rollout.md.
_inPlace_comment: Required in this monorepo: the package vitest config imports ../../../../vitest.(dom.)shared, which cannot resolve from Stryker's copied sandbox. inPlace mutates the real tree and restores on exit — run only on a clean/committed tree.
